method: BASELINE. Written straight from the deposited texts with the writing-l4-rules skill, from the seat of the individual to whom the law is applied, with the design defaults ruled on 2026-10-18; seat-neutral cores (qda-core.l4 for transfer duty, home concessions, clawback and AFAD; qda-admin.l4 for the Taxation Administration Act 2001 as it applies to duty; qda-vehicles.l4 for vehicle registration duty; qda-dates.l4 for shared date arithmetic) with five regulative rules, and a seat layer (qda-seat.l4) that restates no rule; no REFUSE (trusts, ss 93A-94A, the other s 93 cases, the s 246 AFAD exemption and an unlisted kind of vehicle answer an explicit not-covered value, asserted); checked with the stable l4 of VS Code extension 1.6.98, JL4_LIBRARY_PATH unset. No pipeline, no coverage table, no human gate; an independent verification on 2026-10-24 found four minor issues, all corrected (NOTES.md findings 21-24).
edition_encoded: Duties Act 2001 (Qld) act-2001-071 as deposited at ../../registers/source-bundle/act-2001-071.txt (current in-force version on 2026-09-22; in force from 2026-08-01 per the jurisdiction README, still current 2026-10-20); Duties Regulation 2023 sl-2023-0104, version in force from 2025-05-01, at ../../../duties-regulation-2023/registers/source-bundle/sl-2023-0104.txt (s 5(1) and Schedule 2 Part 1 only); Taxation Administration Act 2001 act-2001-072, version in force from 2025-02-28, at ../../../taxation-administration-act-2001/registers/source-bundle/act-2001-072.txt. Not deposited, and so an input or left out: the prescribed interest rate and weekday (Taxation Administration Regulation 2022), the penalty unit value, and the s 153(2) formula, which did not survive conversion (C and OD computed, TD not).

checks.l4: stable l4 of VS Code extension legalese.l4-vscode 1.6.98, JL4_LIBRARY_PATH unset
checks.command: l4 run qda-dates.l4 ; l4 run qda-core.l4 ; l4 run qda-admin.l4 ; l4 run qda-vehicles.l4 ; l4 run qda-seat.l4 ; l4 run qda-cases-buyer.l4
checks.result: 164 assertions written, 164 satisfied, 0 errors, 0 warnings (2026-10-24, after the corrections of findings 21-24); 6 #TRACEs with an expect line (3 breaches, 3 obligations pending), each read and as expected; control copies with one expected value altered reported 1 failure each (147 and, after the corrections, 163 satisfied)
checks.note: l4 run exits 0 even when an assertion fails, so the diagnostics are what was read.
checks.verification: independent verification 2026-10-24: four minor issues (s 246(2)(b)(i) date missing from a Residency value; s 93 answer read the kind of land before the other buyer; the transfer duty question left out AFAD despite s 231(6)(a); the TAA scope lists disagreed), all corrected (NOTES.md findings 21-24)

scope: From the seat of the buyer: Duties Act ss 9(1)(a)-(b), 10(1)(a), 11(7), 12(1), 14(1), 16 and Schedule 2, 17, 19(3) and 20 (regulative), 24(2) and Schedule 3 (as a table); Chapter 2 Part 9 ss 85-90A, 91, 92 with Schedule 4A (as a table), 92A, 92B, s 93(1)(c)(ii) and (7) for two buyers of whom one qualifies (other s 93 cases not covered), s 93B(1)(c) and (3) only to tell when it applies, s 95 (assumed); ss 153, 154 (C and OD; the s 153(2) formula is missing from the deposit), 155 (regulative, with a LEST); Chapter 4 ss 231 (with (5) and (6)(a): the transfer duty in all is Chapter 2 duty plus AFAD), 232 (as a fact), 233(1)(a), 234, 235, 240(1), 243, 244(2)(a) (AFAD at 8%, on the part of the dutiable value for the land), 246(2) (the definition of specified foreign retiree, for s 90A(c)); Chapter 9 ss 377, 378, 379A, 379B, 380, 381 (regulative), 382(2), 383 and Schedule 4C, 390(1)(j)-(m) and (2); Duties Regulation 2023 s 5(1) and Schedule 2 Part 1; Taxation Administration Act ss 13(1)(a)-(b) (as facts), 14A, 30(1)(b), (e), (2) (regulative), 54(1), (2), (5)(aa)(i), (c), (e), (6)(b), (7)(a) and the s 54(7) example (prescribed rate an input; s 54(3)(b) noted, not encoded), 58(1)-(3), 60 (noted), 63(1), (2)(a), 64(1), 65(1) (s 65(2) noted, not encoded), 67(1), 68(1), 69(1)-(3) (regulative). Out: landholder and corporate trustee duty, trusts and partnerships, ss 93A-94A, mortgage and insurance duty, windfall duty, the s 384 reductions, the other vehicle exemptions, the s 246 AFAD exemption, s 154(2)(c) and (2AA), the weekly timing of late payment interest. Read with subjects/au/income-tax-assessment-act-1997/encodings/baseline-2026-10/ (CGT main residence, Subdivision 118-B, a different test from the s 86 home); cross-folder IMPORT is not possible.
seats: the buyer of a home, residential vacant land or a vehicle (the transferee, or the person applying to register a vehicle or to have it transferred into their name)
